northStar: Autonomous any-URL QA (Q1–Q5) · operator UI/UX U1–U2 · packaging S0–S7 · capability M1–M7

Q5.name: Trustworthy site understanding and test-plan quality

history.note: Agent workflow project created; earliest unfinished = M1 (Postgres hard-disabled).
M1 durable store + S1 smoke: databaseConfigured() follows DATABASE_URL/PGHOST; qa_runs/qa_assets persist; Jest health + pipeline + Postgres reload tests.
M2 object store: local HMAC-signed /api/cloud/local, presign uploads + commit, /artifacts static removed, screenshots and run.json stored as objects.
M3 queue + orchestrator: POST publishes runs.requested; lib/orchestrator + workers/orchestrator.js consume with concurrency cap; SSE /api/runs/:id/stream; Playwright still inline until M4.

M4 execution farm: processRun publishes execution.requested and waits for execution.completed; lib/execution/worker.js + workers/execution.js; retries + concurrency caps. Acceptance floor M1–M4 MET. Gaps: M5 auth, M6 LLM, M7 shared cloud queue.

M5 auth + ACL: verified API keys / JWT, tenant-scoped runs, recording CORS allowlist, production KEY_ENC_SECRET required. X-User-Email is not identity. Gaps: M6 LLM, M7 multi-cloud, no UI login screen.
M6 LLM wiring: lib/llm callProvider for OpenAI/Claude/Gemini; BA/Manual/Automation/Manager enrich with template fallback; RPM + cost caps + prompt versions. Gap: M7 multi-cloud adapters.

M7 multi-cloud: lib/cloud/aws (S3/SQS/Secrets Manager/Redis) + lib/cloud/gcp (GCS/Pub/Sub/Secret Manager/Redis); infra/aws + infra/gcp Terraform; CI workflow status + Jest smoke. Default remains ZERO_CLOUD=local. Azure/Vercel not implemented. SDKs lazy-required, not added as runtime deps.
M1–M7 probes green. New packaging workflow S0–S6: S0–S2 done; current = S3 split routes from stages.
S3 split routes from stages: Express handlers in services/api/src/routes/; processRun walks stageKeys in services/orchestrator/processRun.js. Still one process; Chromium remains until S4.

S4 executor image: services/executor/Dockerfile (Playwright) + compose executor service/image zero-executor. Compose HTTP service/image is api/zero-api. @zero/api has no Playwright or worker boot path; jobs consume execution.requested from standalone main.js.
S5 orchestrator image: services/orchestrator/Dockerfile + compose orchestrator service/image zero-orchestrator. worker.js boots without services/api/server.js; the API is HTTP-only.
S6 cloud adapters: packages/cloud/azure + vercel (lazy SDKs) + conformance GATE-9. ZERO_CLOUD=local|aws|gcp|azure|vercel. Packaging S0–S6 complete.

Removed API worker boot paths and app-to-app dependencies; moved execution protocol to @zero/domain and shared run store to @zero/db; made all runtime images workspace-scoped; removed root boot shims; hardened S4–S6 probes. npm start is API-only and npm run start:all is the explicit local compatibility launcher.

Aligned Compose runtime names with target tiers: api/zero-api, orchestrator/zero-orchestrator, and executor/zero-executor. S4/S5 probes now enforce service and image names; stale next-step instructions were removed.

zero-docs reframed: Overview = current state of this branch; added Tech Stack tab (Backend/Frontend/LLM/Data & Cloud/Modules) and a step-by-step Deployment tab. New agent-free generator scripts/generate-lld.mjs (npm run docs) reads every workspace from disk into src/data/generated.ts so the Modules view reflects the live tree without an agent. Fixed stale copy (Checklist 'four images open') and refreshed target-arch.md current-runtime wording + moved architectureV2.html path.
Q2–Q4 product track complete: majorFunctionalCases generation, discovered_flows Playwright execution, domainInference LLM gate on low confidence. Product track Q1–Q4 all green.

Q5 domain + sub-domain classification opened by approved requirement: the Web Analyzer must resolve a domain and a sub-domain from the URL, and that pair must drive case generation. Closes the seam left after Q4 — WEBSITE_TYPES is flat, inferred priorities are written but never read, and majorFunctionalCases is generated before inference runs. Plan published in the zero-docs Next Milestone tab.

Q5 replaced after the first implementation attempt failed to prove user value. The recovery milestone now requires an offline accuracy benchmark, one canonical classification contract, measurable test-plan differentiation, behavioural verification, rollout guidance, and an explicit definition of done. Cache and UI override are deferred until classification quality is proven.

U1 professional operator UI/UX opened by approved requirement: the SPA must become a token-driven, accessible operator console (shell landmarks, type/space scale, daily-flow states, narrow viewport). Parallel to Q5 — DETECT still prefers unfinished product probes; UI work follows /zero-web and prompts/ui-ux.md.
U2 ultra-low-friction canvas opened by approved requirement: single-canvas New Run, hover rail, progressive disclosure of advanced options. Presentation only. Parallel to Q5 and U1.
U1 operator shell (skip link, aria-current, type/space tokens, theme names) and U2 low-friction canvas (nrv--canvas, disclose, hover rail, always-on Run). Product current remains Q5.
zero-docs + workflow prompts synced to runtime: host-scoped agent_memory (002), llm/ split, pathname SPA routes, Run Detail FlowDiagram. Q5 still current; classification keys remain uncached.
